purpose: One separately approved connection diagnostic. No research evidence or evaluation.
prompt: Return exactly this JSON object: {"status":"ok"}. This is a connection test. Do not use tools.
change: Only an actually absent Content-Type on HTTP 200 may be inferred as SSE. A recognized event must pass the frozen gateway validator within a 64 KiB prefix and the existing timeout. Bytes are replayed unchanged; all later gateway and CLI checks remain active. Explicit MIME values, including an empty header, are not overridden. Original response metadata remains recorded.
limits: At most one upstream model POST, 60 seconds, no retry or automatic research restart. CLI context adds input tokens; no exact token or cost prediction.
success: A recognized first event is insufficient. Require completed gateway validation, accepted CLI audit and exactly the expected JSON response.
